system.description:
You launch dozens of near invisible cutting threads of silk, anchoring them between everything that can hold them, across a wide area. Select a point you can see within range, as you manifest a 30-foot cube of lacerating silk threads originating from this point for the duration.

This area is treated as difficult terrain, and if it crosses an area occupied by your Web Anchor, the entire area is also treated as your Web Anchor.

The first time each turn a creature moves through this jutsu’s area, they must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 slashing damage and fall prone on a failure, or half as much damage on a success on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
